title: Continuous homogeneous cocycle of matrix scalar defects
statement: Let $K$ be a field, $S=K^{sep}$ its separable closure and $G=\operatorname{Aut}_K(S)$. Let $A$ be a finite-dimensional central simple $K$-algebra, $n>0$ and $e:S\otimes_K A\simeq M_n(S)$ an $S$-algebra equivalence. Suppose $b:G\to GL_n(S)$ is locally constant for the Krull topology and satisfies $g(e(1\otimes a))=b_g^{-1}e(1\otimes a)b_g$ for every $g$ and $a$. Then there exists a homogeneous continuous degree-two units cycle $z$ [def-sc-galois-units-cohomology] such that $b_g g(b_h)=c_z(g,h)b_{gh}$ for all $g,h$, where $c_z$ is evaluation at $(1,g,gh)$ [def-sc-brauer-scalar-defect].

proof.text: Extract a jointly locally constant scalar defect and its multiplicative cocycle identity from the descent lifts.
Realize this locally constant cocycle by a homogeneous continuous cycle and substitute its evaluation formula in the scalar defect relation.

theorem exists_brauerScalarDefect_cocycle (K : Type u) [Field K] (A : CSA.{u, u} K)
    (n : ℕ) (hn : n ≠ 0)
    (e : (SeparableClosure K ⊗[K] A) ≃ₐ[SeparableClosure K]
      Matrix (Fin n) (Fin n) (SeparableClosure K))
    (b : (SeparableClosure K ≃ₐ[K] SeparableClosure K) →
      Matrix.GeneralLinearGroup (Fin n) (SeparableClosure K))
    (hb : IsLocallyConstant b)
    (hdesc : ∀ (g : SeparableClosure K ≃ₐ[K] SeparableClosure K) (a : A),
      (e (1 ⊗ₜ[K] a)).map g =
        ((b g)⁻¹).val * e (1 ⊗ₜ[K] a) * (b g).val) :
    ∃ z : ContinuousCohomology.cocycles (galoisUnitsTopRep K) 2,
      ∀ g h, b g * Matrix.GeneralLinearGroup.map g.toRingHom (b h) =
        Matrix.GeneralLinearGroup.scalar (Fin n) (galoisUnitsCocycleValue K z g h) *
          b (g * h)
